correctness.rationale: A maximum F_2(G) stable family yields for each base vertex v a coclique neighborhood in G. Since alpha(G)=4, the double-counting bound 2|I|<=16*4 proves |I|<=32. Exhaustive checks find 24/16 four-cocliques and 144/54 reciprocal systems of size-four cocliques; every candidate is independently tested as a stable set of the full 120-vertex token graph. Each solution meets the bound. Automorphism enumeration gives the stated complete orbit profile, and identical-neighborhood classes prove each auxiliary graph is 2K4,4 or C8[2K1]. The package verifier replays all finite checks using standard-library Python.

value.rationale: The two base graphs are the canonical nonisomorphic strongly regular mates with equal parameters, and their 2-token graphs are known to be cospectral. Counting and classifying maximum zero-interference two-particle configurations gives a concrete combinatorial invariant separating their symmetric squares beyond spectra. The natural 4-regular neighborhood encoding produces a two-type structural classification and symmetry-orbit census, rather than an arbitrary subcase or a purely numerical sample.
